title: The Checkpoint Interview
setup_text: HR blocks your calendar slot. The corridor smells like toner and tension. They fold their hands and wait.
setup_text_target: 人事把你卡在日历档口。走廊里是墨粉和紧绷的气味。对方合掌不语，只看着你。
setup_zh: 人事把你卡在日历档口。走廊里是墨粉和紧绷的气味。对方合掌不语，只看着你。
npc_dialogue: 「この四半期、あなたは何を一番に伸ばしたいですか？」
npc_dialogue_translation: What do you want to grow most this quarter?
npc_dialogue_zh: 「这个季度，你最想把什么做起来？」

options.text: 「スキルとキャリアの伸びしろです。」
options.translation: I'd prioritize skill depth and career runway.
options.outcome_text: They stamp APPROVED with unusual warmth and slip you a vendor voucher labeled "training budget." Your deck receives an unexpected polish.
options.outcome_text_target: 对方少见地和颜悦色盖下「同意」，塞给你一张写着培训预算的供应商券。你的牌组莫名被打磨得更顺手。
options.outcome_text_zh: 对方少见地和颜悦色盖下「同意」，塞给你一张写着培训预算的供应商券。你的牌组莫名被打磨得更顺手。

reward.description: A random card in your deck is upgraded.
reward.description_target: 牌组中的一张随机卡牌获得升级。

options.text: 「報酬と裁量の話がしたいです。」
options.translation: I want to talk compensation and scope.
options.outcome_text: They nod slowly. "Everyone wants leverage," they say, and route you a modest spot bonus envelope.
options.outcome_text_target: 对方缓缓点头：「人人都想要筹码。」随手给你转了一笔还算体面的即时奖金。

options.text: 「スコープを一枚削って整理したいです。」
options.translation: I want to cut one piece of scope and tidy up.
options.text_zh: 「想砍掉一项范围，把手头捋干净。」
options.outcome_text: HR stamps "scope reduction" and slides you a red pen — trimming backlog is still work, but it's yours to choose.
options.outcome_text_target: 人事盖上「缩减范围」章，推过来一支红笔——删减 backlog 仍是工作，但至少由你点名。

reward.description: Remove one card from your deck (draw pile, hand, discard, exhaust, or icebox).
reward.description_target: 从牌组或当前牌堆相关区域永久移除一张牌（自选）。

title: The Mentor by the Espresso Machine
title_target: エスプレッソ機の先輩
setup_text: A senior colleague stirs the third espresso of the day. Steam rises; politics thin out into fog.
setup_text_target: 资深同事在搅今天的第三杯浓缩。蒸汽升起，办公室政治淡得像雾。
npc_dialogue: 「この四半期の優先順位、腑に落ちてますか？」
npc_dialogue_translation: Does this quarter's priority stack actually make sense to you?
npc_dialogue_zh: 「这季度的优先级排序，你真捋顺了吗？」

options.outcome_text: They grin. "Rare — someone who read the memo." They share their stash of decent snacks from the last off-site.
options.outcome_text_target: 对方笑了：「少见，真有人读完纪要。」把上次团建剩的好零食分你一半。

options.text: 「いいえ、まだ腑に落ちません。」
options.outcome_text: They sigh. "Honesty costs calories," they warn. The espresso finishes bitter; your shoulders sink with it.
options.outcome_text_target: 对方叹气：「诚实也耗体力。」浓缩喝到尾韵发苦，你的肩膀也跟着塌了一截。

title: The Roadmap Fork
setup_text: The roadmap splits on the whiteboard. Product taps the marker cap — ink or blood, hard to tell.
setup_text_target: 白板上的路线图在此分叉。产品握着笔帽敲了敲——墨水和血丝分不清。
npc_dialogue: 「先行リリースでインパクトを取るか、安定ラインで負債を減らすか。」
npc_dialogue_translation: Ship for impact first, or pay down debt on the safe lane?
npc_dialogue_zh: 「先冲一把曝光还债，还是走稳妥线削技术债？」

options.text: 「インパクト優先でいきます。」
options.outcome_text: The risky lane ships noisy wins — and someone "accidentally" leaves a shiny perk on your desk.
options.outcome_text_target: 高风险路线换来喧哗的胜利——不知谁「顺手」在你桌上留了件亮眼的好处。

options.outcome_text: Numbers flatten; pager noise drops. You sleep enough to feel human again.
options.outcome_text_target: 曲线拉平，告警安静了些。你终于睡到像个人的时长。

title: The Purchase Order Gatekeeper
setup_text: Finance sits under harsh LEDs with an empty tray of PO stamps. Every approval queue looks longer than the fiscal year.
setup_text_target: 财务坐在刺眼的灯下，审批章的印泥见了底。每一条队列都比财年更长。
npc_dialogue: 「今日の発注枠は終わりました…ここからは紙と上司サインだけです。」
npc_dialogue_translation: Today's PO quota is closed… from here it's paper and exec signatures only.
npc_dialogue_zh: 「今天的采购额度用完了……接下来只能走纸质和老板签字。」

options.text: 「わかる。いったんホワイトボードで整理しよう。」
options.translation: Got it — let's park this and whiteboard it.
options.outcome_text: You split snacks and blame the vendor SLA instead of each other. Blood pressure drops company-wide — yours included.
options.outcome_text_target: 你们分了零食，把锅甩给供应商 SLA 而不是彼此。全公司的血压都下来一点——包括你的。

options.translation: I'll route it as urgent spend — keep moving.
options.outcome_text: Cash unlocks nothing in policy land — but they scribble a sticky-note shortcut on your badge sleeve.
options.outcome_text_target: 现金撬不动流程条款——但对方在你工牌套上贴了张抄近道的便利贴。

reward.description: You receive 20 gold from the expedited routing slip.
reward.description_target: 紧急流程的便利贴夹层里摸到 20 枚金币。

options.text: 「俺のチームはまだ余裕がある。」
options.outcome_text: Their smile tightens — then they "find" a rare signing bonus that somehow clears procurement. The envy costs blood; the relic costs paperwork.
options.outcome_text_target: 对方笑容一僵，却从抽屉里摸出一份能通过审批的「稀有签字福利」塞给你。嫉妒让你付出代价，遗物替你付手续费。

reward.description: Lose 6 HP. Gain a random rare relic.
reward.description_target: 失去 6 点生命值，并获得 1 件随机稀有遗物。
